note: Each SmartBite food mapped by hand to one BLS Average Price Data series (area 0000, U.S. city average), fetched from the BLS public API v1. match: exact, close (same food, mixed with its subtypes), broad (no price, kept to show why). Only exact and close get an estimated price. Size: grams (453.6 per lb, or the stated ounces), litres (3.785 per gallon, density from packs.json) or eggs (per dozen). Series with no 2025 or 2026 data in the API (peanut butter, apples, canned tuna, broccoli, peppers, onions, carrots, cucumbers) are not listed.

beef steak.product: Steak, sirloin, USDA Choice, boneless, per lb.

canned sweetcorn.product: Corn, canned, any style, all sizes, per lb.
canned sweetcorn.note: Any canned corn, per lb of net weight; SmartBite packs are drained weight, so the estimate can be low.

dried chickpeas.product: Beans, dried, any type, all sizes, per lb.

dried lentils.product: Beans, dried, any type, all sizes, per lb.

eggs.product: Eggs, grade A, large, per doz.
eggs.note: Price per egg = price of a dozen / 12.

lettuce.note: Romaine; iceberg has only 9 of the 12 months.

orange.note: Only 9 of the 12 months in the period: no price.

plain yogurt 0%.note: All yogurt, any fat or flavour, per 8 oz (226.8 g).

rice.product: Rice, white, long grain, uncooked, per lb.

semi-skimmed milk.product: Milk, fresh, low-fat, reduced fat, skim, per gal.
semi-skimmed milk.note: Low-fat, reduced fat and skim together, per gallon (3.785 l).

wholemeal sandwich bread.product: Bread, whole wheat, pan, per lb.
wholemeal sandwich bread.note: Only 7 of the 12 months in the period: no price.
